title: Benchmark pack
description: One dated file written by your own sync script: per model, a quality score per task class and the current price. dispatch.py reads it and refuses it when it is older than the configured number of days.

generated_at.description: When the sync wrote this pack, ISO 8601 with a time zone.

price_unit.description: What the price numbers mean, for example "USD per million tokens, list price".

fictional.description: True for example data that must never be used for a real pick.

sources.description: Every source a score came from, keyed by a short name.

id.description: The model id exactly as the provider names it today.

provider.description: Who receives the data when this model runs; matched against data_policy.allowed_providers.

scores.description: Quality per task class, keyed by the class names in task-classes.json.

source.description: A key of the top-level sources object.
